$comment: builtin__trigger_create payload for IronClaw 1.4.0 (execution_contract schema, verified against the binary on 2026-09-17). Deferred tools return their schema on first call — call trigger_create twice if the first reply carries a 'note' asking to call again.
name: jyotish-weekly-muhurta

execution_contract.goal: Scan the coming 7 days for muhurta windows for each activity listed in the user's config/activities.json (default: GoodLunarDayForTravel) at the primary chart's location by calling mcp-jyotish-local__muhurta__find with from_utc=now, to_utc=now+7d, step_minutes=60 for each activity. Rank the top 3 windows per activity and include the passed_rules and vetoed_by trails verbatim.
success_criteria: muhurta.find was called once per configured activity
Each activity lists up to 3 windows with start/end in local time and the rule trail
execution_contract.output_instructions: One section per activity: ranked windows with rule ids that passed and vetoed.
execution_contract.no_result_text: No muhurta windows passed the rules this week for the configured activities.
